hook_text: 1 m = 100 cm, so 1 m² = 100 cm²? Not even close.
clip_script: One metre is one hundred centimetres. One square metre is a square one hundred centimetres by one hundred centimetres, so its area is one hundred times one hundred: 10 000 square centimetres. The poster is sixty centimetres by forty centimetres: 2 400 square centimetres. In square metres: 2 400 divided by 10 000 is 0,24 square metres. Check using metres from the start: 0,6 metres times 0,4 metres is 0,24 square metres.
visual_style: A one-metre square fills with a 100 by 100 grid of tiny squares; a counter races to 10 000; a poster shape slides in covering 0,24 of it.
pacing: Wrong guess, grid fill, poster reveal.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to convert any area unit with confidence.
